concepts.name: Project context
concepts.description: Concise AGENTS.md facts agents need on most tasks — not full API dumps.

concepts.name: Permissions
concepts.description: Allow / Ask / Deny baseline. Secrets blocked; production needs approval.

concepts.name: Plan mode
concepts.description: Read-first planning for expensive or hard-to-undo changes.

concepts.name: Skills
concepts.description: Repeatable procedures loaded only when relevant.

concepts.name: Sub-agents
concepts.description: Narrow delegated investigations; main agent verifies results.

concepts.name: Verification
concepts.description: Run the real app and prove acceptance criteria.

concepts.name: Independent review
concepts.description: Fresh-eyes review before production, without editing app code.

concepts.name: Context clearing and compaction
concepts.description: Fresh context for unrelated work; compact only mid-task clutter.

faq.a: No. Run only the phases a change needs. A bug can go straight to /debug.

faq.q: When should I use plan mode?
faq.a: Database, auth, migrations, payments, production infra, large refactors, or anything hard to undo. Not for typos or small style fixes.
Framework, package manager, important commands, main directories, testing, DB conventions, design and security rules, deployment restrictions. Keep it short.

faq.q: When should I use a skill instead of project rules?
faq.a: Skills are procedures for a phase. Rules are always-on facts. Use skills when you enter a workflow phase.

faq.q: When should I use a sub-agent?
faq.a: Parallel exploration, research, test planning, or security review — with a narrow purpose and no deploy authority.
Deny rules block .env and credentials where the runtime supports it. Instructions alone are not enough; inspect skills before install.

faq.q: Does the workflow deploy production automatically?
faq.a: No. Deploy, DNS, and production actions require explicit human approval.

faq.q: What happens when a decision is unresolved?
faq.a: Ask. Do not invent. /develop gates to /architect when a load-bearing decision is owed.

faq.q: When should I clear or compact context?
faq.a: Clear for unrelated work. Compact only when continuing the same task and context is cluttered.

skills.name: Scope

skills.name: Audit

skills.name: Architect
skills.description: Records important technical and product decisions in docs/specs/.

skills.name: Develop
skills.description: Implements an approved specification in small, reviewable steps.

skills.name: Check
skills.description: Verify runs the real app; review is independent fresh-eyes code review.

skills.name: Test
skills.description: Writes and runs meaningful tests for normal, edge, error, and a11y paths.

skills.name: Document

skills.name: Sync

skills.name: Debug
